versions.changelog:
- Linked the skill to the Overpowered suite and added suite metadata, including suite_url.
- Updated the description to explicitly mention part of the Overpowered skill suite.
- Retitled section as "Overpowered / Dry Run" for clearer suite association.
- Removed the legacy skill-card.md file.

Initial release: add skill for simulating side-effecting operations (“dry run”) before committing changes.

- Describes the core rule and procedure for performing dry runs.
- Details an output contract to standardize simulation reports.
- Lists common pitfalls and limitations (gotchas).
- Includes stop conditions for when a dry run is considered sufficient.
- Target use: risky, hard-to-reverse, or highly visible actions.
